Subject: Discovery recap: observability + evals (dashboards, golden prompts)

Jordan / Priya - thanks for a productive call. Below is a short recap + proposed next steps. Please reply with any clarifications or edits.

Summary of pain points (from our discussion):
- Latency variability on current hosted provider causing timeouts for clinicians during shift change (spikes during 2pm-4pm PT).
- No systematic alerting for quality regressions after model updates; currently relying on manual QA sampling.
- Lack of tracing hooks to link API calls back to user/session metadata for debugging.
- Need dashboards that show token-level cost by route, per-prompt success rates, and golden-prompt regression trends.

Current stack and constraints:
- Frontend: React + Next.js; backend: Python FastAPI with Gangway proxy to outbound LLM provider.
- Primary data residency: US; SOC 2 required for vendor.
- Current traffic profile: 20k requests/day with peak 5k/hour during clinical peak.
- Budget: evaluating vendors for pilot; cost sensitivity around per-token spend at scale.

Success criteria for a pilot (what ZenHealth needs to see):
1) Observability: per-route dashboards (latency P50/P95, token cost, error rates) and a tracing hook that surfaces user_id, session_id, and request metadata in our logs.
2) Evals: ability to run golden prompt sets against baseline and new model variants with regression alerts (email + Slack) when quality drops beyond threshold.
3) Rollout guardrails: canary/A-B rollout support with automatic rollback if latency or quality SLOs breach.
4) Compliance: SOC 2 evidence and support for customer-managed KMS.

Proposed Redwood deliverables for a 6-week pilot:
- Demo dashboard bundle: latency/cost/quality views tuned to ZenHealth routes (attachment: redwood-observability-demo.pdf).
- Tracing hooks and integration guide for FastAPI + Gangway proxy (small SDK + example).
- Golden prompt set onboarding: we'll help you define 25-50 golden prompts and ingest the initial set; you'll provide the clinical examples and acceptance criteria.
- Regression alerts: baseline + threshold config; email + Slack integration.
- Rollout guardrails: canary policy template and automated fallback to baseline model.

Open questions / action items from the call:
- Jordan/Priya: share a sample of 20 clinical examples for golden prompts and a copy of the current SLA matrix by 3/24. (ACTION: Jordan)
- Marissa/Rishi: provision a demo dashboard and a sample tracing SDK by 3/26. (ACTION: Marissa/Rishi)
- Stephanie: coordinate SOC 2 evidence handoff and KMS integration notes. (ACTION: Stephanie)

Attachments: zenhealth-obs-requirements.xlsx (your notes), redwood-observability-demo.pdf (sample dashboards).

Next meeting: proposed pilot kickoff Wed 3/25 10:00am PT - please confirm availability.

Thanks again - looking forward to getting a pilot in place.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
